metadata.name: User Population Characteristics
metadata.description: Distributions and strategies governing synthetic user population generation. Extends Step 2's organizational_structure/communication_scale with the attribute-level distributions Step 1 requires (activity level, behaviour profile, frequent-contact prevalence, active hours, preferred categories).

user_identifier_generation_strategy.external: {environment_id}_ext_{8-char hex}, guaranteed unique within environment; disjoint namespace from internal ids

ip_address_allocation_strategy.internal: Drawn from the department's network_segment CIDR (Step 2 network_configuration.network_segments) if defined, else the environment's default internal_ip_ranges entry.
ip_address_allocation_strategy.external: Drawn from a placeholder public address pool (203.0.113.0/24, TEST-NET-3), representing PSTN/internet-originated endpoints outside the modeled internal network.

phone_extension_strategy.internal: 4-digit extension, unique within environment, formatted as a string ('1000'-'9999').
phone_extension_strategy.external: Synthetic E.164-like number, format '+1-555-{7 random digits}', not guaranteed globally unique (mirrors real-world caller-ID reuse/spoofing).

sip_identifier_strategy.internal: sip:{user_id}@{organization_domain} — every internal user is SIP-registered.
sip_identifier_strategy.external: null for pure PSTN-style external contacts; populated for the subset of external users flagged is_softphone_external (see external_softphone_ratio below), using sip:{user_id}@{external_domain}.

organization_domain_strategy.external: Assigned from a small per-environment pool of synthetic partner/vendor/public domains (3-5 per environment), reused across multiple external users to model calls from the same organization.

community_membership_note: Internal community membership = department_id (Step 2 organizational_structure), consistent with Step 5's community_based_selection mechanism. External users' community = their assigned organization_domain, so external users from the same partner/vendor cluster together the same way internal departments do.
